subject: how to limit the y scale when using stat_summary

messages.author: 166e40180306ffff
messages.subject: how to limit the y scale when using stat_summary
parts:
Hello

I'm having the follwing problem. When I use the stat_summary function
to plot means, there's often to much space reserved for the y-axis,
since the range of means is much smaller than the range of the raw
data. When I limit the y-axis to a smaller range that does not include
all raw data, stat_summary function doesn't work anymore:

df<-data.frame(x=gl(5,20),y=rnorm(500,100,100))
p<-ggplot(df,aes(x=x,y=y))
p<-p+stat_summary(fun.y=mean,geom='bar')
p
p+ylim(-50,200)

Any solutions?

Kind regards,

Erich

messages.author: 166e40180306ffff
messages.subject: Re: how to limit the y scale when using stat_summary
parts:
Ok, forget about it, I already found the solution myself:

p+coord_cartesian(ylim=c(-50,200))

Anyway, I think, it would be a good idea to add an example like this
to the documentation of stat_summary.

Kind regards,

Erich
